Actuator favorites & performance plots

Robot Body Atlas v0.2.1 · Snapshot: 29 October 2026. This is a research catalogue, not a standardized independent benchmark or a procurement ranking.

The interface, filters and catalogue summaries support Chinese and English. Source-specific technical notes, manufacturer documents, papers, JSON downloads and the original performance workbook retain their original language. Translation does not change a numeric value, unit, evidence level or hardware revision.

Using the workbench

  1. Use a model’s star in cards, lists or details to save that specific model / voltage configuration.
  2. Open Favorites to use the saved set. Brand and numeric filters still apply. You can also save the current filtered results together.
  3. Open Performance plot and choose X and Y metrics. Examples include mass versus rated output torque, or gear ratio versus peak output torque.
  4. Choose linear or logarithmic scales, color by brand/category/encoder, swap axes or show model labels.
  5. Hover, click or select a point with the keyboard to inspect the model, original metric conditions and source links. When points overlap, use the model picker below the figure to select the exact record.
  6. Download the current SVG figure with its legend, or the plotted-point CSV with exact values, conditions and source URLs.

Favorites and scope

Favorites are saved in this browser and do not automatically synchronize between browsers, devices or website origins. Clearing browser storage removes them. Favorites are separate from the existing four-model parameter table and have no four-model limit.

The default plot scope is complete modules / servos. Bare and frameless motor values refer to the motor shaft and can be selected separately. Mixing them triggers an explicit scope note. Rated, peak and stall torque are independent choices.

Missing data and calculations

A model missing either coordinate is excluded rather than plotted as zero. The excluded-model list explains the reason. Log axes exclude zero and negative values; reported zero values remain available on linear axes.

Rated torque / mass and peak torque / mass are calculated from the corresponding reported metrics with positive mass. These are not standardized independent torque-density tests. Read thermal conditions, duration, mass scope and qualifiers. Overlapping coordinates can be explored with filters, labels and the model list.

Next steps

Potential extensions include multiple collections, import/export and synchronization, box zoom, overlapping-point exploration, uncertainty intervals, condition-matched groups, and equivalent workbenches for robot bodies and hands. Reuse stable record IDs and evidence links while defining each section’s metric semantics separately.

Read the full original Chinese handoff for the complete source-language technical record. The English page is a maintained guide, not a replacement for the original evidence.
